title: Compute covariance under a stated convention

items.prompt: Paired observations x=[0, 1, 2], y=[1, 2, 3]. Compute population (divide by N) covariance cov(x,y). N=3.
items.solution: The means are 1 and 2. Sum centered products = 2; divide by 3. A covariance does not by itself establish independence.
